1981.notes: Cleveland Codified Ordinances § 191.0501 (Rate and taxable income; American Legal Publishing) states: 'on and after March 1, 1979, the rate of such tax shall be a total of one and five-tenths percent (1.5%) per annum; and that on and after January 1, 1981, the rate of tax shall be two percent (2%) per annum.' So 2.0% applied for all of 1981 (the city's 2002 CAFR says only that voters approved the increase 'in 1981'); the ACIR 1984 edition prints 2.0% as the 1983 rate.
